name: Splash
description: Serve supported models on Apple Silicon with speculative decoding, Metal kernels, and coding-agent integrations.
compatibility: OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, and Completions; Anthropic Messages; documented Pi launch command.
limitations: Requires Apple M3 or newer and macOS 26.4 or newer; memory requirements depend on model and quantization.
Model and draft downloads need network access on first use.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
